[[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.11''' was the twenty-third update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 26th of May 2020. It introduced the [[Pursuit]] tower, multiple tower and enemy reworks or balances, and other gameplay changes. Unlike with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was an official name for this update, that being the '''Smaller = Bigger Update'''. '''Release v1.11''' has been retroactively applied to this update to keep in line with the numbering scheme with the other updates. This version encompassed three updates, the main Release v1.11.0 update (released 26 May 2020) and four minor updates, the Release v1.11.1 (released 31 May 2020), Release v1.11.2 (released 4 July 2020), Release v1.11.2a (released same day as Release v1.11.2, 4 July 2020) and Release v1.11.2b (released 5 July 2020). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Pursuit]] *[[War Machine]] (Exclusive)
